NAVINFLUOR.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
NAVINFLUOR.about: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is primary engaged in producing refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides, specialty organofluorines and offers contract research and manufacturing services.[1] Its portfolio includes 50+ fluorinated compounds developed over the years.[2]
NAVINFLUOR.keyPoints: Overview[1] NFIL, a part of the Padmanabh Mafatlal group, is present in the fluorochemical industry since 1967 and is one of the largest specialty fluorochemical companies and a pioneer in manufacturing of refrigerant gases in India. NFIL’s product portfolio comprises 60+ fluorinated compounds, with them finding application in various industries, like agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, aluminium smelting, refrigeration, metal processing, abrasives, glass and ceramics. The company is currently headed by second-generation entrepreneur, Vishad Mafatlal, who has over 25 years’ experience in textile and chemical sectors

HDFCBANK.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
HDFCBANK.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges. [1]
HDFCBANK.keyPoints: Market Position: The company is India's one of the 3 systemically important banks with a 15% market share in the banking sector’s advances and a 37% market share in the private sector banks’ advances as of FY24. It is also the second-largest bank in India.[1] It is among the top 3 Government Banks collecting direct and indirect taxes for the Government of India.[2] It is a market leader in almost every asset category. [3]

INFY.name: Infosys Ltd
INFY.about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation.[1] It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS.[2]
INFY.keyPoints: Digital Services: It comprises of services and solution offerings of the group that enables clients to transform their businesses. It includes offerings that enhance customer experience, leverage AI-based analytics and big data, engineer digital products and IoT, modernize legacy tech systems, migrate to cloud applications and implement advanced cyber-security systems.[1]

RELIANCE.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
RELIANCE.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.
RELIANCE.keyPoints: Architecture Reliance Industries Limited holds key business stakes, including 66.43% in Jio Platforms (RJIL). Additionally, it maintains an 83.56% ownership each in Reliance Retail Ventures and Reliance Consumer Products, alongside a 59.59% holding in JioStar.[1]

BHARTIARTL.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
BHARTIARTL.about: Bharti Airtel Ltd is one of the world’s leading providers of telecommunication services with presence in 18 countries representing India, Sri Lanka, 14 countries in Africa. [1]
BHARTIARTL.keyPoints: Segments & Presence[1] Mobile, Broadband, DTH and Bank. The company has operations in India, Africa, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.

LT.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
LT.about: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate which is primarily engaged in providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions in key sectors such as Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, Information Technology and Financial Services in domestic and international markets.[1]
LT.keyPoints: Business Segments[1] a) Infrastructure Projects (47% in FY26 vs 51% in FY25): [2] The segment undertakes EPC activities across buildings and factories, transportation, heavy civil infrastructure, power transmission and distribution, renewable energy, water and effluent treatment, and minerals and metals sectors.

SUNPHARMA.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
SUNPHARMA.about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market.[1] It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India.[2]
SUNPHARMA.keyPoints: Product Offerings:[1][2] The company produces a range of generic and specialty medications for chronic and acute conditions. Its product portfolio includes generics, branded generics, specialty pharmaceuticals, advanced technology-based products, antiretrovirals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and intermediates. It offers medications in multiple dosage forms, such as injectables, sprays, ointments, creams, liquids, tablets, and capsules. The company offers 27 products in the global specialty market, with a strategic focus on dermatology, ophthalmology, and onco-dermatology segments.[3]

TITAN.name: Titan Company Ltd
TITAN.about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO). [1]
TITAN.keyPoints: Part of the Tata Group[1] [2] The company benefits from its association with the Tata Group, one of India’s most established and diversified business conglomerates. As of FY26, the Tata Group held a 25% stake in the company, including a 21% shareholding through Tata Sons Pvt Ltd., while Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation Limited (TIDCO) held 28%.

BAJFINANCE.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
BAJFINANCE.about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)
BAJFINANCE.keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] The company is India's largest private-sector Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), catering to both individual and business customers through a portfolio of financial products and services. Its offerings span loans, fixed deposits, payments, insurance, and mutual funds through its mobile app, website, and social media, and through its branch network.

MARUTI.name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd
MARUTI.about: The Company was established in 1981. A joint venture agreement was signed between the Government of India and Suzuki Motor Corporation (SMC), Japan in 1982. The Company became a subsidiary of SMC in 2002.It is the market leader in passenger vehicle segment in India. In terms of production volume and sales, the Company is now SMC’s largest subsidiary. SMC currently holds 56.28% of its equity stake. The principal activities of the Company are manufacturing, purchase and sale of motor vehicles, components and spare parts.
MARUTI.keyPoints: Segment wise domestic sales 9M FY26[1] Compact - 41.6% Utility vehicles - 37.7% Vans - 7.3% Mini - 5.3% Mid Size - 0.1% LCV - 2% Sales to other (OEM) - 6%

DEEPAKNTR.name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
DEEPAKNTR.about: Incorporated in 1970, Deepak Nitrite Ltd manufactures Basic Intermediates, Fine & Speciality Chemicals, Performance Products, and Phenolics[1]
DEEPAKNTR.keyPoints: Business Segments:[1] The company is one of the fastest growing chemical intermediates companies in India with a portfolio of 36+ products and 56+ applications, divided into 2 segments: a) Phenolics (68% in FY26 vs 70% in FY25): [2][3][4] The company produces Cumene, Phenol, Acetone, Isopropyl Alcohol, Alpha Methyl Styrene (AMS), etc., catering to industries like laminates & plywood, automotive, construction, pharmaceuticals, and adhesives. It is the largest producer of Phenol and Acetone in India with a 50% market share. b) Advanced Intermediates (32% in FY26 vs 30% in FY25):[5] [6] The company manufactures Nitrites, Nitro Toluidines, Xylidines, Oxyimes, Cumidines, Optical Brightening Agents (OBA), DASDA, etc., serving industries like colorants, dyes, rubber, paper, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, water treatment, etc. It is India's largest producer of Sodium Nitrite and ranks among the top 3 global manufacturers of Xylidines and Oximes.

DIXON.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
DIXON.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, incorporated in 1993 , is a Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) company with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras (CCTVs), and mobile phones. It also undertakes reverse logistics operations. Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India.[1]
DIXON.keyPoints: Business Segments:[1] a) Mobile & EMS Division (90% in FY26 vs 85% in FY25):[2][3][4] The company has emerged as the fastest-growing EMS company by revenue and market capitalisation. It manufactures feature phones, smartphones, IT hardware, Telecom, hearables & wearables. Its key client in this segment includes Samsung. b) Consumer Electronics & Appliances (6% in FY26 vs 9% in FY25):[5][5][4] The company offers LED TVs (32-98 inches), Smart TVs, Monitors, IFPD Commercial displays, Digital signage PCB & LCM panel assembly, and LED Bar Injection moulding. It is the largest Original Design Manufacturing (OEM & ODM) company in India, and has a 37% share in outsourced manufacturing. Its clients include Xiaomi, Samsung, Hisense, Panasonic, Acer, Toshiba, BPL, Lloyd, VU, Motorola, etc. c) Home Appliances (3% in FY26 vs 4% in FY25):[6] [4] The company is an ODM/OEM in India, manufacturing Semi-Automatic Washing Machines (SAWM) and Fully Automatic Top Load (FATL) models for both domestic and global markets, holding about 35% market share in SAWM and around 15% in the FATL segment. It offers a product range of 175+ SAWM models and 20+ FATL models. Its clientele includes Bosch, Godrej, Voltas -Beko, BPL, Sharp, Onida, Reliance, Flipkart, Croma, and Lloyd, etc. d) Lighting Products (1% in FY26 vs 2% in FY25): The company offers a range of LED products, including lamps, battens, panels, strip and rope lights, downlighters, street and flood lights, and smart lighting solutions, with 2,000+ variants across consumer and professional lighting categories. It is also among the largest ODM players in this space, holding around 25% market share in consumer lighting manufacturing. Its Clients include Signify, Wipro, RR Kabel, Crompton, Havells, Orient, Bajaj and Eveready.

KAYNES.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
KAYNES.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments.[1]
KAYNES.keyPoints: Business Offerings:[1] The company is a leading provider of end -to-end IoT-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing services (IEMS). It offers a full spectrum of services across the entire electronics value chain, spanning conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support.[2] It has also ventured into Smart Metering, Advanced Semiconductor Packaging (OSAT), High-Density Interconnect PCBs, and AI-Powered Railway Safety.[3]

POLYCAB.name: Polycab India Ltd
POLYCAB.about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.
POLYCAB.keyPoints: Business Segments[1] [2] a) Wires & Cables (87% in FY26 vs 84% in FY25): [3] [4] The company is India’s leading manufacturer of wires and cables, including flexible wires, building wires, optical fiber cables, rubber cables, control cables, and special-purpose cables, etc. It offers over 9,650 SKUs across retail and industrial applications and commands a 30-31% share of the organized domestic market.

TRENT.name: Trent Ltd
TRENT.about: Trent Ltd is engaged in retailing of apparels, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery & non food products through various of its retail formats/ concepts.[1]
TRENT.keyPoints: Part of Tata Group:[1] The company is a part of the Tata Group with ~37% of group shareholding, 32.5% with Tata Sons Private Ltd & 4.3% with Tata Investment Corporation Ltd. [2] Tata Group comprises 100 operating companies in 7 business sectors. The group operates in over 80 countries across 6 continents.

ETERNAL.name: Eternal Ltd
ETERNAL.about: Incorporated in 2010, Eternal Limited (previously Zomato Limited) is one of the leading online Food Service platforms in terms of the value of food sold. Its offerings include food delivery, dining-out services, Loyalty programs, and others. As of December 31, 2020, Eternal has established a strong footprint across 23 countries with 131,233 active food delivery restaurants, 161,637 active delivery partners, and an average monthly food order of 10.7 million customers.[1]
ETERNAL.keyPoints: Business Segments - Q2 FY27:[1][2] Eternal Limited operates four principal businesses: - Zomato (food delivery) - Blinkit (quick commerce) - Hyperpure (B2B supplies) - District (going-out).

CREDITACC.name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
CREDITACC.about: CreditAccess Grameen Limited is registered as a non-deposit accepting NBFC - Microfinance Institution with the RBI. It is engaged in providing microfinance services to women who are enrolled as members and organized as Joint Liability Groups. It also uses its distribution channel to provide certain other financial products and services to the members. [1]
CREDITACC.keyPoints: Market Leadership:[1] CreditAccess Grameen is a microfinance institution in India, providing financial services to low-income households, primarily women, in rural and semi-urban areas. It holds a 6.9% market share in the overall microfinance industry.

HAL.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
HAL.about: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL), a 71.64% Government-owned Maha-Ratna CPSE, designs, manufactures, upgrades and provides lifecycle MRO for aircraft, helicopters, aero -engines, avionics /accessories and aerostructures, principally for India’s armed forces.[1]
HAL.keyPoints: Business Segments 1) Manufacturing The five-complex model covers: 1) Fixed-wing aircraft: LCA Tejas, Su-30MKI, Do/Hindustan-228, HTT-40 and legacy fleets 2) ⁠Helicopters: ALH/Dhruv-NG, LCH, LUH, Cheetah/Chetak and future IMRH/DBMRH 3) AL-31FP, RD-33 and Shakti engines 4) Avionics, LRUs and accessories 5) Aerostructures, castings and forgings 6) Aircraft, rotorcraft, UAV, engine and airborne-system R&D[1]

ASIANPAINT.name: Asian Paints Ltd
ASIANPAINT.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

PIDILITIND.name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
PIDILITIND.about: Pidilite Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer of adhesives and sealants, construction chemicals, craftsmen products, DIY products and polymer emulsions in India. Most of the products have been developed through strong in-house R&D. Our brand name Fevicol has become synonymous with adhesives to millions in India and is ranked amongst the most trusted brands in the country. Some of our other major brands are M-Seal, Fevikwik, Fevistik, Roff, Dr. Fixit, Fevicryl, Motomax, Hobby Ideas, Araldite. [1]
PIDILITIND.keyPoints: Revenue Breakup Company earns about 53% of its revenues from adhesives & sealants category, followed by Construction & paint chemicals (20%), industrial resins & construction chemicals (7%), art & craft materials (6%), industrial adhesives (6%), and pigment & preparation (6%).. It has its business divided into 2 divisions, consumer & bazaar products which account for ~80% of revenues, and B2B products segment which accounts for ~20% of revenues [1] In total,the company produces ~650 products for its brands. [2]

CLEAN.name: Clean Science & Technology Ltd
CLEAN.about: Incorporated in 2003, Clean Science and Technology Ltd is one of the leading chemical manufacturers globally. It manufactures functionally critical specialty chemicals such as Performance Chemicals (MEHQ, BHA, and AP), Pharmaceutical Intermediates (Guaiacol and DCC), and FMCG Chemicals (4-MAP and Anisole). [1]
CLEAN.keyPoints: Product Segments (FY26):[1][2] a) Performance Chemicals (72%): The company manufactures Monomethyl Ether of Hydroquinone (MEHQ), which is used as a polymerization inhibitor in acrylic acids, acrylic esters, super absorbent polymers (diapers and sanitary pads), Butylated Hydroxy Anisole (BHA), used as anti-oxidant in food and feed industry, Ascorbyl Palmitate (AP), used in infant food formulations, breakfast cereals, and cosmetics, Tertiary Butyl Hydroquinone (TBHQ) used as a stabilizer in the oil industry and Hindered Amine light Stabilizers (HALS), used in water treatment and UV stabilization in a variety of polymers. TBHQ ranks 2nd globally, while the rest of the products are ranked no.1. b) Pharma & Agro Intermediates (19%): It manufactures Guaiacol (ranked 2nd globally & 1st in India), a precursor to manufacture APIs for cough syrup and key raw material to produce Vanillin, Dicyclohexyl Carbodiimide (ranked 2nd globally & 1st in India), used as a reagent in anti-retroviral, Veratrole (amongst largest in India), an intermediate in agrochemical industry and DHDT (No 1 in India), used as a reagent in anti-retroviral. c) FMCG Chemicals (9%): It manufactures 4-Methoxy Acetophenone (4-MAP) (No 1 globally), used in UV blockers in sunscreens, and Anisole (No 1 globally), used as a precursor to perfumes, insect pheromones, and pharmaceuticals. The majority of Anisole produced is used for captive consumption.
